## Summary
Describe the self-contained enhancement or widget to add.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Uses `PrismTheme::from_ctx(ui.ctx())` tokens instead of hardcoded colors
- [ ] Works in both dark (`Obsidian`) and light (`Frosted Light`) themes
- [ ] Showcased in `crates/demo`
- [ ] Passes `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy`, and `cargo test`

## Helpful Pointers
Link relevant files in `crates/egui-prismglass/src/` to help contributors get started quickly.
